label: UI Int
short_description: Bind an integer property on a UI object
long_description: Provides bidirectional access to an integer property on a UI object. The set port pushes the input value to the named property; the changed callback fires when the property changes externally (e.g. via user interaction in the UI), emitting the new value on value_out.

parameters.name: Object
parameters.description: Name of the UI object to bind to (matches the object's name in the UI definition).

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Name of the integer property on the UI object to read and write.
